concepts.name: CONSUMPTION, SAVING AND INVESTMENT UNIT
concepts.simple_definition: INTRODUCTION 89 UNIT 4: CONSUMPTION, SAVING AND INVESTMENT UNIT 4 CONSUMPTION, SAVING AND INVESTMENT INTRODUCTION “Consumption is the sole end and purpose of all production.” — Adam Smith In the previous unit, we saw that consumption is an important element of the GDP of an economy
concepts.deep_explanation: In this unit, we will study the nature and relationships among the three important macroeconomic variables: consumption, saving and investment

concepts.common_confusion_amharic: [አማርኛ] ተማሪዎች ይህንን ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ከሌሎች ተዛማጅ ርዕሶች ጋር ሊያደናግሩ ይችላሉ።
